lines.name: CARD
lines.text: Final hand. Tommy “The Shark” Maio turns over two kings and the whole rail stops breathing.

lines.name: CARD
lines.text: The river bricks. Thirty years at this card room, and the old man finally has his trophy.

lines.name: TOMMY
lines.text: Thirty years! You hear me? Thirty years!

lines.name: MILES
lines.text: His name goes on the board by the cage. Next month, it could be yours.
